description: This file is a FastAPI router module for managing notes in a note-taking application. It defines API endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and toggling properties like pinned and favorite status of notes. The file utilizes dependency injection for database sessions and user identification, and it processes note data through service layer interactions.
